justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Large comparative study shows residency-trained PTs do not outperform entry-level on outcomes; fellowship does.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 12-month post-graduation residency; stipend-based but significant opportunity cost relative to clinical salary.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Residency training adds clinical depth applicable across the chosen specialty caseload.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No residency-specific billing premium in most payer contracts; does not unlock new billing codes.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Growing employer demand in academic medical centers, VA system, and specialty PT programs.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: No difference in patient satisfaction vs entry-level in available studies.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Indirectly supports cash-pay by accelerating board specialization in marketable areas (ortho/sports/pelvic).
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Signals expertise that supports higher cash rates, especially paired with a specialty.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Still relatively uncommon among PTs; clear differentiator.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Builds your skill ceiling but is fundamentally about you, not a scalable model.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumers don't know what a residency is.
justifications.business.efficiency: Year of reduced salary plus intensive hours; costly path for purely business goals.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: ABPTRFE residency is a gold-standard credential for academic clinical hiring and promotion.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Residency culture explicitly trains case reports, presentations, and publications.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Residency-trained PTs are heavily preferred for lab and clinical instruction.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Curricula are evidence-based with mentored EBP integration.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Frequently listed as required or strongly preferred in DPT faculty postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: High time/income cost, but among the most efficient routes to academic clinical credibility.
